title: Laredo Breaks Ground on Shiloh Bike Trails
excerpt: The City of Laredo broke ground Thursday on the Shiloh Bike Trails project, part of a larger plan to connect trails across the city.
content:
The City of Laredo broke ground Thursday on the Shiloh Bike Trails project, joined by District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King.

The project is part of a bigger vision to expand trail connections across the city, giving riders more places to ride without leaving their own neighborhoods.

Local cyclist Jorge Munoz, who has been riding since 2008 or 2009, said the new trails are close to home, friendly to riders, and a good fit for kids and beginners.

The Laredo Cycling Association was recognized at the groundbreaking for its efforts to bring the trails to life.
